title: Tan Wool Mod
description: A mod that adds tan colored wool to Minecraft.
body:
A simple Minecraft mod that introduces a new tan-colored wool block designed to blend naturally with existing wool variants. This block was created to support more accurate shading and improved detail in 16x scale Minecraft head builds.

![Tan Wool block shown next to White Wool and Brown Wool blocks.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/puxO1Rxo/images/61986b92fcefe52ea93c3a51ebe199673e269184_350.webp)
